item.title: 24: Daily Halacha: A Message for Rosh Hashanah: Life Is Fickle
item.description:
What does Rosh Hashanah's long Musaf teach about a year of uncertainty? Its nine blessings, unlike the seven of other festivals, correspond to the nine mentions of HaShem's name in Hannah's prayer.
